title: Pre-existing CI debt — Forbidden Patterns regex + expert-invocations-queue CI env skipIf
description:
EPIC-158 — 修 EPIC-157 (v3.32.2) 4-branch flow 暴露的 2 个 pre-existing CI 算法债. 独立 ticket, 不混 EPIC-157 scope (per Rule 7 scope-check).

**Debt 1: Forbidden Patterns Check regex false-positive** (.github/workflows/kallax-ci.yml)
- 现状: `grep -rn ': any' --include="*.ts"` 抓 JSDoc prose `fail-closed: any error` 等非类型断言 (e.g. node/src/permissions/authz-check.ts:5, node/tests/l1-match.test.ts:9)
- CLAUDE.md "Stage 1 regex false-positive 沉淀" 已记录, 但 workflow 实际规则仅排除 `.d.ts`, 未应用 `^\s*\*\s` 跟 `^\s*//\s` 排除
- 修复: 在 Forbidden Patterns Check 步骤加 `--exclude-dir node_modules` + grep 后置 filter `grep -v -E '^\s*(\*|//)\s'`
- 影响: PR #176 + #177 + #179 都因这个 false-positive fail (跟 EPIC-157 内容无关)

**Debt 2: expert-invocations-queue.test.ts:120 CI env fail** (node/tests/expert-invocations-queue.test.ts)
- 现状: 测试期望 `'sqlite'` 但 CI 环境无 SQLite 时 backend 自动降级 file, 测试 fail
- 错误: `expect(result._unsafeUnwrap()).toBe('sqlite')` vs `queue.health().backend === 'file'`
- 修复: 加 `describe.skipIf(!process.env.KALLAX_TEST_SQLITE_AVAILABLE)` 跟 check-live-test-guard.sh 模式一致 (per EPIC-114)
- 影响: PR #176 coverage gate 因这个 fail exit 1

**跟现有 Rule 联合 (0 冲突)**:
- EPIC-114 live test skipIf pattern: ✅ 复用
- CLAUDE.md Stage 1 false-positive 沉淀: ✅ 应用
- Rule 7 scope-check: ✅ 独立 EPIC, 不混 EPIC-157
- EPIC-069-D check-claim-evidence: ✅ 0 README/CHANGELOG 数字 change, scope-zero

**scope**:
- 改: .github/workflows/kallax-ci.yml (regex), node/tests/expert-invocations-queue.test.ts (skipIf)
- 不改: source code (kallax/node/src/*), docs (CLAUDE.md 仅加 EPIC-158 段)
- 不动: EPIC-157 任何文件
